fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects suspicious ways to download files or content using PowerShell
fields.name: PowerShell Web Download
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains ".DownloadString(" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".DownloadFile(" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "Invoke-WebRequest " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "iwr "))
